CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_time_blocks (
 id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
 task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 starts_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
 ends_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
 created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CONSTRAINT ck_task_time_blocks_order CHECK (ends_at > starts_at),
 CONSTRAINT ck_task_time_blocks_length CHECK (ends_at - starts_at <= interval '12 hours'),
 CONSTRAINT ck_task_time_blocks_same_day CHECK (starts_at::date = (ends_at - interval '1 microsecond')::date)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_task_time_blocks_user_starts ON task_time_blocks (user_id, starts_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_task_time_blocks_task_id ON task_time_blocks (task_id)
